I wish I had taken more time to read all the one-star reviews before deciding to work with this company. I hired them to design a website for my holistic acupuncture practice, expecting a truly custom design aligned with my brand and business model.

These guys are not web developers, and they do not know much about web development. The final product did not reflect what was promised. The term “custom design” was used in a way that did not match the actual deliverable. Beginning with a blank Wix template and applying minimal stylistic changes does not constitute custom web design. There also appeared to be a significant disconnect between holistic medicine branding and conventional biomedical or corporate aesthetics. The overall tone, imagery, and execution felt misaligned with the clearly stated focus of my practice.

When I expressed concern that the design did not reflect my vision or business identity, the feedback I received framed the issue as a “creative shift” rather than acknowledging a potential misunderstanding of the brand direction. Additionally, certain requirements - such as the need for me to independently supply stock imagery - were not clearly disclosed prior to purchase.

When concerns were raised, I expected collaborative problem-solving and professional dialogue. Instead, communication centered on contractual defenses and even threats rather than addressing the underlying design misalignment.

This review reflects my documented experience so that others can make informed decisions. Client retention is best achieved through transparency, alignment with client vision, and professional execution.

It's too bad you're going to lose clients after the way you treated me - they have every right to understand others’ experiences before investing their money.

*** Responding to their comment down below that is not factual or true ***

The homepage was not delivered within the stated timeline (actually had I not fired you, it probably would have taken many more weeks to complete it), and when it was finally presented, it did not reflect the information or direction I had provided. I was genuinely surprised by the quality of what was delivered, especially given that it was presented as aligned with my business and vision.

There was no clear disclosure upfront that clients would be responsible for sourcing stock images and effectively designing the website themselves. That was the service I believe I was paying for.

When I raised concerns about the misalignment in color palette, tone, and overall aesthetic, I expected collaborative problem-solving. Instead, the responsibility was shifted back onto me. At that point, I chose to end the working relationship, as it did not make sense to continue investing time and energy into a process that was not producing results. The delays and repeated revisions were costing me time and money.

I ultimately initiated a formal dispute due to the poor quality of the work delivered and the denial of my refund request.

Threatening with arbitration and defamation in response to legitimate client concerns was both delusional and toxic. When a client raises legitimate concerns, the focus should be on resolution - not intimidation. And honestly, why did you think that it would work? That's just disgusting attitude. I do not have the time or energy for business relationships that create unnecessary stress and drama.

I'm not even surprised to read their generic response to my comment. I took the time to read through all their responses to 1 star reviews. Quite laughable honestly to continue to defend your lack of professionalism and poor quality of work.The overall experience was not professional - they think about only money and not the client.

You never want to be working with a company so out of touch with reality and so malignant. Literally just be normal, it's not necessary to be so hostile to someone whose money you're taking.

Look elsewhere.

A terrible experience.  Completely Incompetent.  I am sure the owner will respond, as he does for the other negative reviews with an agenda to have the review removed.   For a project, I contacted 8 different firms, with many competitive and competent.  10com by far was the worst with unable to understand how to use their own booking system, followed by spamming and poor customer service.

Disappointing Experience and Lack of Service

I had a very disappointing experience with 10com Web Development. I initially signed up for website development and SEO services, and after speaking with a representative named Mark, I made a full payment based on the promises made.

Unfortunately, the process quickly turned frustrating. I received no clear updates or reports regarding SEO, and communication became inconsistent. After weeks of waiting, I was sent a homepage for approval, which required several corrections. Later, I received a five-page website draft—but it contained multiple errors and looked rushed. I had provided over 40 professional photos for the project, and only 4 were used, repeated across all pages.

When I expressed my dissatisfaction and requested a refund due to the poor quality and lack of progress, the company refused. I feel that I received little to no value for the money I paid and cannot recommend this company based on my experience.

I am extremely disappointed with my experience so far. It’s been over 2 months and I still don’t have a website. Lots of back and forth. They don’t let me talk to anyone, everything is done via email. I feel like I could have done it better and faster with ChatGPT and a generic template.

I want example of functionality and they don’t implement that. Just add visuals. Super frustrating and a waste of time and money.

I want my site published and to be done with them. I DO NOT recommend.

I am surprised to see all the 4 and 5 star reviews for this company as this was not the experience I received. During the initial take on my project for a logo design, I specified what I wanted from the very beginning and they didn't provide it for me. With constant going back and forth, misspelling in the logo, and providing you with something you don't ask for this company is frustrating. They don't ask questions and when you tell them you're frustrated they say you have an underlying tone. They say they will be in contact with you for 3 to 5 days, that's not the case. I emailed Mark B who is a manager and it took him 7 days to respond to my email. I'm trying to start a business so a delay like this doesn't look good on their part. Look elsewhere for a company that actually listens to your initial concept. This company does not.

Update: this company is still a joke. I got my refund. They claim that you're their top priority and this is not the case. I'm telling you right now, if you're thinking about booking with this company, do not book with them. They don't listen to anything that you want at the beginning stage of designing your logo and they send you stuff that doesn't even look good. Like I said before LOOK ELSEWHERE. This is not the company for you.

This review is specifically for Mark B. Kattie was pretty easy to work with. Mark on the other hand, not so much. From taking his sweet time to not actually making the corrections as expressed the first time or at all. I eventually just wrote down what I would later correct after parting ways with them. He responded to me 8 days after I’d asked for assistance with my domain.   After expressing my confusion of dealing with my domain and reaching out for assistance I was met with adamant resistance. The directions he sent wasn’t working as he’d described and he wasn’t sending over the proper information to go through the two step authentication. The directions through email wasn’t working and Mark first expressed how he was so busy and so was his team when I’d asked for further clarity via phone. I dismissed him after this as this was the final step that I would clearly need to handle on my own. He then responds with an email stating how they were no longer working with me and he was ready to discuss working with me as if it is some type of threat. As a client I can express that I did not have the best of experiences. They’ll come here with some long story as to how they are the best and there’s another side. Umm no. You’re not that great. Take the criticism and move on.

Worst service imaginable! They don’t appear to have the tools or development skills to perform even basic website development. Their business model is maddening. They assign a client rep to each account whose singular role is to transmit information between the customer and the developers. What’s worse is that they will not interact directly with customers as a matter of policy. They don’t do phone calls or zoom/teams even if requested. So all comments have to be conveyed by e-mail to the client rep, who simply forwards the e-mails to the developers, with whom the customer cannot interact at all! They don’t make you aware of this ‘no talking’ policy until they have your money. It took forever to turn around the most basic comments (sometimes as much as a week) and 30% of my changes were missed on each iteration, requiring me to make the same comments over and over again. The final product was an ‘F’. We canned it after more than a month of back and forth and had to start over from scratch. I would avoid this service at all costs.

If you want to lose business for months on end while this company slow walks creating a website for you, then this is the company for you! After waiting from February to June for a simple website that should have taken weeks, the manager Mark declared the website launched, but I was never able to access it when I put in my business name.  I kept sending screen shots to him to show that WIX said it wasn’t launched. They kept sending me the link by email.  What they didn’t bother to tell me is that the website was connected to a domain that was not the name of my business. I discovered that only 3 days ago on December 7!  They called my inquires “an ongoing series of unfounded allegations” and it was only when I had no recourse to threaten them with an outcome they would not like that they severed communication with me. How dare I complain that effectively this company cost me business because neither I nor my clients could access this website until two days ago when I purchased the correct domain name and connected it myself!  Therefore, they didn’t deliver the service that matched my business. I did!  How do you like that for customer service?!

On top of that it took them 9 months to deliver another website for which I delivered most of the copy. I got a once-a-week, terse email response when I was lucky. I was unable to get anyone on the phone. There is no system set up for that.  When you complain you get shamed and blamed.  Beware and steer clear.

The response from 10 com is defensive and untrue, as expected.  I was only able to connect to the website when they sent me a link to the incorrect domain name.  That was the ONLY time I was able access it.  If the name of my business is not the name of the domain name they connected the site to, you can hardly call that "live."

They NEVER bothered to point out to me that the incorrect domain name was what they had connect the website to after months of sending them screen shots of the message I got saying it wasn't connected.  Is that an example of diligence on their part?! They just kept saying I should be careful that I was putting in the correct name of my own business.  Yes, the domain name was incorrect and that is an issue I have with that company.  But if I kept asking 10 com for 4 months to explain the discrepancy, one would think they would have bothered to tell me so.

Mark B only demonstrates disrespect for the customer and takes no responsibility for his lack of responsiveness.  And, in fact, I NEVER threatened him, unless you consider that I demand a response by a certain date or I would have no choice but to take action he wouldn't like only a week ago. I am well positioned to make promises.  I don't need to make threats.

You get what you pay for... The quality of work was ok (they seem to outsource most work), but the communication, project management, and leadership were utterly horrible throughout the project. The final straw was when we ran into a problem; instead of offering any solutions, we received a string of excuses followed by being completely ghosted. Be careful what you use this company for and do not use them for anything complex.

This project isn't completed but I haven't  had a good experience so far.  The team I am working with Mark and Kattie, have not communicated clearly to be from the very beginning. One thing I found unacceptable is they claimed to have sent me content for my review, later I discovered they didn't actually send me the content but sent it to one another (addressed to me in the body of the email) and I only found this out after my own investigation.  Now since this discovery was pointed out to them, they have been lacking in communicating. I am displeased with this service so far and I paid in full to work with them.   I wouldn't recommend this service if you are on a timeline, as they don't communicate clearly and they will ignore any communication attempts you make with them. Just beware.

Admittedly, I am a beginner! Im in the process of building a new website for an online business I’m launching at the end of the month. I asked this company to develop a logo with animation, which I clearly explained in my design requirements. I received a logo without animation. When I explained that I had asked for animation, I was told I’d need to purchase another package for $149.99. Realizing I would need a logo anyway, I purchased the animation package and received a proof that couldn’t have been any further from what I was expecting. When I explained the situation they told me I’d need to purchase ANOTHER package ranging in the thousands. When I said I was not prepared to spend that much and asked what refund options were available, since I would not be using the animation that’s made, they were unwilling to help. To be honest, I felt really dooped and taken advantage of. I realize I’m a beginner developing an online business, however, I’ve made a career in sales and recognize how damaging to a business relationship it can be when you don’t admit fault and explore how to make it right for your customer. The treatment, specifically by the Development Business manager, Mark, forced me to terminate the relationship. Not the kind of experience I was wanting or would have forced a client into in my line of work. My advice would be to explore other options.

***In response to 10com comment***

I received neither a usuable animated logo, nor the return for the money I paid for it, so to say that you want me to have the end result I was wanting couldn’t be further from reality. I hope your treatment of your future customers improves.

***In response to 10coms AMENDED response. ***

For anyone reading this, 10 coms below description of events was made after they responded to my original google review highlighting their exploitative and abusive business practices. In that response, they publicly tried to gaslight me, saying that all they wanted was for me to happy with the end result of the process, which they then deleted and replaced with what is below. The response below is an attempt to discredit and devalue the experience I had instead of leaving an apology. I think it is worth noting that after I wrote this review, the company issued me a refund. Basically, this is an incredible and unnecessary amount of drama for what is supposed to be a transparent and transactional relationship. There are so many options for your web development needs and life is too short for this level of unprofessionalism.

A good company to go with if you do not have a creative idea for your branding needs. They are not adaptive to an established vision and struggle to meet client needs. My project took an additional 3 months which was primarily due to the response time from Mark B and the constant revisions. After numerous failed attempts to get the project on track, we eventually had to get Wix involved in order to receive a response from Mark B. We then decided to pull the plug on the project. I was left with an incomplete website and a useless infographic. I reached out on multiple occasions in order to address my concerns directly. Our calls where not returned and virtual appointments where not accepted.You get what you pay for. My advice is to pay more and hire true professionals

HORRIBLEEEEEEE. I was hopeful because of the reviews but they're either fake or bought. Very unprofessional. They are so cheap because you get what you pay for. All I wanted was a logo and they kept sending me the same free Wix logos you can make yourself and they were awful. Of course I am no longer working with them ut BEWARE! GO SOMEWHERE ELSE!!! I promise it's not worth it

I hired this company for website development including main page and 6 additional pages and am not satisfied with their services. Please note thier process even though they will tell you in the beginning is not a good one. There is no direct communication allowed between you and the designer. The middle man will type all your needs and then put in project pipleline. After that it will be cascade of emails to make any single change no phone calls.  It will take you many iterations to really get the idea produced and in raw form by that time you will run out of your 2 revised changes, they will simply rely on you to pretty much ask all changes. The level of design they will provide is very basic in my opinion. if they will disagree and bring legal team in every escalation to threaten you, my guess is even this post will be threatened very soon, however, this was my true experience with 10 com. I appreciate the help but extremely dissatisfied overall so sharing it with you all.

Absolutely abysmal service and results.  It took more than 3 months to get a 3-page web site from these jokers and nothing was what I asked for.  I never write negative reviews but this one needed to be written.

I felt like I had to walk them through the entire process. It took well over the time frame I felt was appropriate. I had to repeat many requests and fix numerous things myself. Not worth the time or money I spent.
Company that only cares about their bottom line and doesn't care about customer.

Don't waste your time or your money on this web designer.  They will try to nickel and dime you to death and never produce a website.  I fired them for lack of production and they still have the nerve to ask me for money.  You get fired, you don't get paid.  I finally found a better designer that did my site in 1 week.  Shop around and avoid these clowns.
